# 460: #394 Pi 400 U-Boot GENET fix (discard counter masked out of the RX producer index, PR #465 8cfe2362)

**Result: fail.** With the fixed U-Boot (B), **16 of 20** serial reboots reached `redox login:` without a manual `boot` (pass needs 20 of 20). Boots 2, 4, 6 and 8 stopped at the U-Boot prompt after all 3 HTTP and 3 TFTP tries for the image failed. Retries were not rare: **19 of 20** B boots had at least one failed DHCP try or load. **The discard count in RX ring 16 was non-zero in 25 of 44 B dumps** (values 4 to 98). The consumer index never ran ahead of the producer index (equal in 43 of 44 dumps). A (old U-Boot, new netboot.scr) happened to give 10 of 10 this time (5 boots with retries); its 4 ring dumps show discard 0 and consumer = producer, so the expected A signature didn't appear.

- Image: row 325's (`v0.5.0-dev-90-g92a6387c+x54e8`, `harddrive.img.gz` untouched), Pi 400, netboot from `/srv/tftp/pi400/`, serial ttyUSB1, SD slot as it was. No person, no power cycle. 2026-11-16, 12:09–13:18 UTC.
- Built in my own worktree `~/redox-rpi-pitest-retry` (detached at 8cfe2362, nothing switched in a shared clone):
  - `u-boot.bin` (B): `scripts/build-uboot.sh rpi-net <host> pi400` with the build lock, sha256 `160022ee…`. Patch check: `grep DMA_P_INDEX_MASK upstream/u-boot/drivers/net/bcmgenet.c` gives lines 141 (`#define DMA_P_INDEX_MASK 0xffff`), 342 and 414. The U-Boot source (my clone's) was reset to the clean tag afterwards.
  - `u-boot.bin` (A): row 454's build from a50b9423, sha256 `ecc4021a…` (the same file as in 454).
  - `netboot.scr` (A and B): `scripts/netboot.sh --server <host> --board pi4`, sha256 `5fc0c37a…`, with `redox_netdiag='md.l 0xfd580c00 0x60; md.l 0xfd580394 2; md.l 0xfd583000 0xc'`.
- Before: u-boot.bin `0aafc622…`, netboot.scr `a55675cf…` (row 325 state), copies kept.

Observations (my reading, not checked further):
- **Discard non-zero in B boots 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 13 and 14.** Of the four failed boots, three (4, 6, 8) had a non-zero discard; boot 2 failed with discard 0. Boots 3, 12, 13 and 14 had a discard and still came through on a retry.
- **The producer index in the failed boots 4, 6 and 8 sits around 0x7b00–0x8xxx and crosses 0x8000 during the boot.** In boots 12 and 14 it jumps from a low value (0x06e1, 0x013d) to about 0x7aed–0x7ffa within a few seconds, far more than the frames that could arrive in that time. So the index may be set or wrapped there by something other than received frames. Worth a look in the driver's ring setup and index arithmetic around 0x8000 (a 15-bit or signed comparison?).
- The consumer equals the producer in 43 of 44 B dumps (boot 6's last dump: producer 0x0142, consumer 0x0141). So when the dump runs, after the failed command, the driver has caught up. The dump may be too late to show the state at the moment of the loss.
- The other ring words are constant in every dump: 0xfd583010 `01000800`, 0xfd58301c `000002ff`, 0xfd583024 `00000001`, 0xfd583028 `00050010`.
- MIB error counters (FCS, alignment, length, overrun) as in 454: see the full dumps.

### Afterwards

Old `u-boot.bin` and `netboot.scr`/`netboot.cmd` back at 13:15:59, **hashes checked: `0aafc622…` and `a55675cf…`, the same as before.** Serial reboot with the old files: `redox login:` at 13:18:16, row 325's banner, after 3 manual `boot`s at the U-Boot prompt (the old files fail the same way). `/srv/tftp/pi400/harddrive.img.gz`/`manifest.toml` were not touched, and `keep/pi400-combo-stage/` is unchanged (`1534ee85…`).

Files on <build host>: `~/pitest-tools/t460/` (events.txt, A-boot-01…10.log, B-boot-01…20.log, boot-restore.log, fulldumps.txt, perboot.md, both u-boot.bin builds, the generated netboot.scr, the old files, uboot-build.txt, patch-check.txt).
